exposure: Uterine bleeding control method (intrauterine continuous running suture vs. figure-of-eight suture)
finding: Intrauterine continuous running sutures significantly reduced postpartum blood loss and transfusion units during cesarean section in pregnant women with placenta previa compared to figure-of-eight sutures.
mod_finding: This study found that using intrauterine continuous running sutures during cesarean sections for women with placenta previa significantly reduced blood loss and transfusions compared to figure-of-eight sutures.
